issues.display_title: Issue #202: Release GoThru Photo Studio App 1.1.10 Version
issues.main_description_html:
GoThru Photo Studio — Version 1.1.10 Release Notes

We are excited to announce the release of GoThru Photo Studio 1.1.0! This milestone update introduces a massive under-the-hood architecture upgrade alongside brand-new editing tools to streamline your workflow.

🚀 Major Performance Enhancements

  • Migrated Framework from Electron to Tauri: Re-engineered the core desktop engine using Tauri. This shift dramatically reduces memory consumption, speeds up launch times, shrinks installer size, and provides a faster, overall smoother user experience.

✨ New Features

  • Scale Up Image: Increase image resolution without sacrificing clarity. Sharpen details and upscale your visual assets effortlessly.

🧪 Beta Features

  • Object Remover (Beta): Clean up shots by easily erasing unwanted elements, clutter, or artifacts from your photos.
  • Stitch 360 Panorama (Beta): Seamlessly align and stitch raw captures into full 360° equirectangular panoramas right within the app.

🐛 Bug Fixes & System Optimizations

  • Resolved minor UI rendering glitches during batch processing.
  • Fixed application stability issues during high-resolution asset exports.
  • General performance tweaks and overall stability enhancements.

Demo by Developer

  • https://github.com/GoThruMedia/gothru-photo-studio/releases/tag/1.1.10
